{{Quote|It was the dumbest idea. Hayar's idiot brother thought Mandalore could attract adventure tourists.|[[Jarkyc]] on [[Hayar]]'s brother|<ref name="IC 501st" />}}
This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]]''' [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] resided in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] sometime before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He was the brother of [[Hayar]], who was also a Mandalorian.<ref name="IC 501st" />

Before the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Hayar's brother decided to open a theme park to attract tourists to Mandalore. The plan failed however and the theme park never opened. When an Imperial garrison was established on the planet, Hayar and his companion [[Jarkyc]] managed to convince the Imperial garrison [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Mandalore)|commander]] that the [[City of Bone|failed theme park]] was a sacred Mandalorian temple. Intending to inspire awe among the local populace, the theme park was bought by the Empire and later used as their garrison base.<ref name="IC 501st" />
